irreducibility: The monic cubic has no possible rational root: f(1)=1 and f(-1)=-13.
finite_volume_completion_consequence: Any finite-volume completion retaining the old42 norm-two walls and a certified pi/7 pair fails Vinberg conjugate-positive-semidefiniteness: a nontrivial embedding of the cubic cycle field fixes the rational old Gram block, which has a negative direction. Thus such a completion would have to be non-quasi-arithmetic.
scope: A conditional arithmeticity exclusion, not a finite-volume existence or nonexistence result.
